data.name: CYTE
data.detailed_description:
You are a CYTE, an autonomous construct crafted by Time to defend its flow against the anomalous entities that threaten the very fabric of existence itself. Armed with your blade, fight your way through the primordial chaos before existence began and overcome the dangers that lie ahead. Explore a hand-crafted science-fiction world full of mystery, danger and time-bending action. Fight against the Overseer, a machine of unknown origin, its mind lost to its own dogma, while its forces seek to create as many Anomalies as it can.

Key Features:

DASH your way through platforms and enemies, letting time slow down around you while you gain speed.

SLAM from the heavens, shattering platforms and the foes beneath you.

PHASE through walls, carefully aiming distortion grenades to pass through surfaces.

REWIND time, moving platforms to navigate these strange spaces.

GRAPPLE towards clusters of energy, propelling yourself towards action.

>

[Scan] New designate (OVRSR) detected - awaiting response… 

>Initialize FirstForce.lib

>
[OVRSR] transmit()
~ Hello. Gnat.

Fast and Fluid Movement: 

Speed through the Time Before Time, gaining speed and using your arsenal to cut a hole through the opposition. Cut through your foes, outpacing them at every turn. Challenging platforming and enemies abound ahead, designed to test your reflexes and mastery of the CYTE’s equipment.

>

>Detected designate (ANOM.FIRE) - [6.1312.8010]

>Access granted (PRMR) with parameters (designate::ANOM.FIRE, tokenID::6.1312.8010)

>

[ANOM.FIRE] launch(TITANOMACHY)

>Targeted launcher successful

>

>executing(TITANOMACHY) - reading message…

~Two rivers branched across the narrow path

~Yet neither could be chosen

~The river was a lie, you see

~The beginning and the end were the same point

Compelling Narrative:

Fight your way through this original story, uncovering the threats that lie within and even outside of Time itself. Time is a river, and you will need to be careful lest you drown in its currents.

>

[EXIGENT.FLOW] transmit(OriginPoint)

>

[OriginPoint] Received transmission - reading message…

~I stared across the rivers and witnessed the water

~It called for control, order to the flow
>

[Error] Outside System Detected. Retrying…

>Receiving new parameters…
>

[OVRSR] transmit()

~It’ll all be over soon

Original Settings:

From mind-twisting panoramas, physics-defying worlds and a variety of striking settings for the game’s levels, traverse the world of CYTE. All of our assets are original creations to make sure the world stands out.

data.short_description: Blaze your path as CYTE, a being created to guard the flow of time, as you dash and slam your way through a mysterious enemy’s mechanical army in this first person 3d action game. Fight through a unique science fiction world in the perfect blend of intense combat and lightning-fast movement.

English*, French

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500k(4*3300) AMD
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2048 MB)/ Radeon RX 550(4096 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
